mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Firemans Park with a temperature of 71 degrees. The full moon is out, and we have a special treat tonight as the International Space Station will be visible at 3:25 AM. Look for it rising in the west over Mount Horeb, moving northeast toward the Madison area near the Home Depot, and reaching about halfway up the sky. Overnight, temperatures will drop to a low of 61 degrees with no rain predicted.

Mayor Diaz has officially proclaimed September as National Senior Center Month, celebrating the center's role in our community. Additionally, the Senior Center is hosting a new tri-shaw bike program that offers free 30-minute rides for seniors along the Military Ridge State Trail, with volunteers piloting these electric-assist machines.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Verona Downtown Farmers Market today at Hometown Junction Park. Also happening today is Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Hop Haus tomorrow, or head to Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company this Thursday for more live music.

Regarding local activity, on August 17, officers responded to a request from the Department of Corrections and successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop in and enjoy a scoop.
